title: TITAN-VIBE: Virtual Intact Block Extraction for periodic reconstruction
description: TITAN-VIBE 1.0.2 adds a runnable Windows x86-64 executable, complete buildable TITAN host source with HoloLift omitted, and replay drivers for the deposited VIBE inputs. VIBE algorithms are unchanged from v1.0.1. Distribution version 1.0.2 is separate from the embedded frozen TITAN host build identity. Release checks and input/output provenance are included.
